title: Trump Provides Fresh Boost To Quantum Computing Space, Signs Two Orders - IBM, INFQ, QBTS, RGTI, QUBT Stocks In Focus
source_used: Reuters report of 22 Jun 2026 (read as carried by NBC News), ABC News (22 Jun 2026), and the Stocktwits article (fulltext/C15-03.txt)
key_facts: President Donald Trump signed two executive orders on Monday 22 Jun 2026 on quantum technology.

The first pushes a government effort to build a powerful quantum computer for scientific research; Michael Kratsios, director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, said "We believe this can happen by 2028."

The second sets a goal of moving key government computer systems to post-quantum cryptography by 2030 or 2031, to protect them from quantum-fuelled cyberattacks (Reuters); the Stocktwits article gives 2031.
Another measure tells agencies to plan for deploying quantum-enabled sensors and networks within five years.
Reuters says the orders reflect the administration's priority on leading China in the quantum race.
The month before, the Commerce Department announced $2 billion in equity stakes across nine quantum-computing companies, including a new IBM venture (Reuters).

The Stocktwits article repeating this news carries a 13 Oct 2026 date in the pool but its page metadata shows it was published on 22 Jun 2026; IonQ's 12 Oct 2026 release also refers to the White House executive order of 22 Jun 2026.
quote_evidence: President Donald Trump on Monday signed a pair of executive orders designed to protect domestic quantum computing and accelerate its development of the technology.

Trump signed two executive orders, one of which seeks to protect government computers against quantum computer-fueled cyberattacks by setting a goal of migrating key government computing systems to post-quantum cryptography by 2030 or 2031.
Last month, the Commerce Department announced it would take $2 billion in equity stakes across nine quantum-computing companies, including a new IBM venture.
why_it_matters_hint: Sets dated federal goals for a science-grade quantum computer and for quantum-safe encryption, but it is old news repeated in this week's pool.
notes: STALE, RE-DATED. The pool lists the Stocktwits article as published 13 Oct 2026, but its page metadata says datePublished 2026-06-22 and the text says the orders were signed 'on Monday' (22 Jun 2026). Confirmed by Reuters (carried by NBC News) and ABC News of 22 Jun 2026, and by IonQ's 12 Oct 2026 release. The pool item is a single-source Stocktwits piece that credits the WSJ and Reuters; credit goes to Reuters, whose text was read at NBC News. Nothing new today. Stocktwits gives 2031 for the cryptography target; Reuters says 2030 or 2031; eWeek says key establishment by 31 Dec 2030 and digital signatures by 31 Dec 2031.
